title: Three-Month Launch Delay
summary: A real trade-off with conflicting stakeholders. This one needs a room.
shortRequest: Should we delay the product launch by three months?
request: Should we delay the product launch by three months?

intro.headline: Meetings are not the problem.
lines: Some decisions genuinely need a room — and a decision layer has to be able to say so.
Revenue, product quality, customer commitments and engineering capacity all pull in different directions.
SYNCLESS does not avoid this meeting. It sizes it, and walks in prepared.

before.verdict: The wrong meeting: too many people, no pre-collected positions, and usually a second meeting after it.
before.note: The problem is not that this needs a meeting. The problem is that nobody sized the meeting before booking it.

analysis.headline: This decision involves conflicting trade-offs between revenue, product quality, customer commitments and engineering capacity. It cannot be resolved in writing — real-time discussion is required.

reasoning: Only 34% of what this decision needs exists as fact — the rest is a judgement about risk appetite.
Sales, Engineering and Finance returned directly opposing conclusions. Async collection cannot reconcile them.
Stakeholder conflict is high: revenue, product quality, customer commitments and engineering capacity trade against each other.
The decision is irreversible within the fiscal year, which raises the bar for synchronous time.
SYNCLESS still sizes the meeting down: 4 decision-makers, 30 minutes, with every position pre-collected.
